_comment: Gateway rates for the README demo hub. Invented vendors, invented prices.
The two providers deliberately serve the SAME model id at DIFFERENT rates.
That is the case the consumption table exists for: a gateway that fails
over reaches one model through several upstreams on several contracts, and
a row keyed on the model alone would add two invoices together.
Nothing here is anyone's real contract. Do not copy these numbers.
Rates are CNY per million tokens. Both sides must be positive: a model
with no output tokens needs a unit+price pair or a free allowance instead,
which is why there is no embedding model in this demo.
